name: Belmopan (Belize)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, green and yellow, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the seal of the City of Belmopan.
history: Belmopan was founded in 1970 as the new capital after Hurricane Hattie devastated Belize City. Its yellow-and-green flag with the city seal was first reported in 2013; the seal was later amended to add the city's name. No adoption date has been published.

features.role: seal of the City of Belmopan
